# Disability Categories

**Part:** Part 2  
**Generated by:** `scripts/generate_parts.py` (A.12 reassembly, stub-capable)  
**Source DB fingerprint:** `6c9c22d8c0f4`

---


23 populations are represented. Categories group related functional profiles; no category or population is ranked above another (D-NAV-006).


## Category: cognitive

### `DEM` — people living with dementia
Alzheimer disease and related dementias


## Category: developmental

### `ADHD` — ADHDers; people with ADHD
ADHD

### `AUT` — autistic people
Autism spectrum

### `ID` — people with intellectual disability
First-class (supersedes the DEM+NDV proxy). Person-first per the People First movement.

### `NDV` — neurodivergent people
Broad neurodivergent category; includes AUT, ADHD, and others


## Category: general

### `ALL` — applies to all populations (scope marker)
Item is not population-specific; applies to everyone

### `BAR` — fat people; people in larger bodies
Body-size group; frame as the environment wrongly normed to an average body. Served by A-SIZE.

### `LPA` — little people; people with dwarfism
Body-size group; cultural-identity community. Served by A-SIZE. "Midget" is a slur.

### `TALL` — tall people
Body-size group; included for fit. Served by A-SIZE.


## Category: mental_health

### `MH` — people with mental health conditions
Mood, anxiety, trauma, psychotic disorders affecting environmental tolerance


## Category: mobility

### `LMB` — people with limb differences; upper-limb disabilities
Was UPL.

### `MOB` — disabled people with mobility needs; wheelchair users
General mobility limitation including walking, balance, or wheeled mobility

### `SCI` — people with spinal cord injuries
Spinal cord injury, paraplegia or tetraplegia


## Category: neurological

### `BRAIN` — people with acquired brain injury
Incl. post-concussion, stroke, TBI. Merges former NEU + PCS.

### `EPI` — people with epilepsy
Epilepsy and seizure disorders; photosensitivity is a relevant subtype

### `MOVE` — people with movement disorders
Tremor, dystonia, Parkinson's. Pairs with A-PRECISION.

### `MS` — people with MS
Multiple sclerosis; thermoregulation, fatigue, motor and sensory involvement

### `VES` — people with vestibular disorders
Served primarily by A-STABLE.


## Category: pain_fatigue

### `COM` — people with complex conditions
Complex/energy-limiting: dysautonomia, long COVID, MCAS, ME/CFS, POTS. Merges OFS+CFS+MCAS+POTS (+LCOV).

### `PAIN` — people with chronic pain
Chronic pain conditions; sustained discomfort affecting endurance and posture


## Category: sensory

### `BLIND` — blind and low-vision people
Identity-first convention; "visually impaired" is disliked by much of the community. Was VIS.

### `DEAF` — Deaf and hard-of-hearing people
Hard of hearing, Deaf, or late-deafened

### `DEAFBLIND` — DeafBlind people
Cultural movement with its own language (Protactile), centring touch. Not VIS+DEAF. Was DBL.
